courses.title: ECG Interpretation Essentials
courses.summary: Read rhythm strips with confidence: rate, rhythm, axis, intervals and the ten patterns you will meet most.
courses.audience: Nursing staff, junior doctors, paramedics and students who see ECGs on shift but don't yet read them confidently.

tryInstead.reason: You want hands-on emergency skills rather than interpretation
You already read ECGs and want to understand the cardiac drugs behind them

courses.title: Basic Life Support Refresher
courses.summary: Current adult, child and infant BLS sequences, team roles and high-quality CPR metrics.
courses.audience: Any healthcare worker who needs to refresh resuscitation skills, from students to senior staff.

tryInstead.reason: You already know BLS well and want the next step: recognising dangerous rhythms
You want ward knowledge rather than emergency skills

courses.title: Clinical Pharmacology Basics
courses.summary: Pharmacokinetics, dosing in renal and hepatic impairment, and the interactions that matter on the ward.
courses.audience: Nurses, pharmacists and doctors who prescribe, check or give medicines on the ward.

tryInstead.reason: You want a short, practical course you can finish in one sitting
You're more interested in evidence and publishing than day-to-day prescribing

courses.title: Medical Research Writing
courses.summary: Structure, write and submit a clinical paper: IMRaD, reporting guidelines and responding to reviewers.
courses.audience: Clinicians and postgraduate students planning to write up a case, audit or study for publication.

tryInstead.reason: You want clinical knowledge you can use on shift rather than writing skills
You want a beginner-friendly clinical skill with quick wins
